import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

describe('orders', () => {
  it('totals an order', () => {
    expect(1 + 2).toBe(3);
  });

  it.skipIf(!process.env.DATABASE_URL)('saves an order to the database', () => {
    expect(process.env.DATABASE_URL).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it.todo('refunds an order');
});
